summary: Phase 2 (Raspberry Pi agent) end-to-end validation: 57/57 backend pytest cases pass (34 Phase 1 regression + 23 new Phase 2 for agent endpoints). Pairing token format XXXX-XXXX-XXXX validated on create + regenerate. Full agent flow tested: /api/agent/pair, /api/agent/heartbeat (with Authorization: Agent ), /api/agent/cameras, /api/agent/detected-cameras, /api/agent/thumbnail (success + 413 oversize + 404 cross-tenant), /api/agent/event (success + 404 cross-tenant), /api/agent/download (401 without auth, 200 returns smartcam-agent.tar.gz containing install.sh + smartcam_agent/agent.py + client.py + heartbeat.py + camera_loop.py). Python agent CLI 'pair' verified — config.json correctly stores user-provided api_url (NOT the server-returned internal URL) plus api_key, device_id, name. Frontend /devices page: 'Descargar agente' button downloads tar.gz (27KB); after pair+heartbeat the device card shows ONLINE badge, CPU °C (42.1°), CPU % (25%), IP (10.0.0.99) and the pairing token in XXXX-XXXX-XXXX format. Frontend /cameras renders + LIVE badge when last_thumbnail is present.

minor.issue: Pair endpoint accepts the same pairing_token multiple times and re-issues a fresh agent_api_key each time (old key is overwritten and silently invalidated). Acceptable for now (idempotent re-pair) but consider invalidating the token on first successful pair so a leaked token cannot be reused — currently the only way to invalidate is the user clicking 'Regenerar'.

When thumbnail_b64 exceeds MAX_THUMB_B64_LEN it is silently truncated instead of returning 413 (different from /agent/thumbnail which returns 413). Inconsistent behaviour; either truncate both or reject both.
Endpoint walks /app/agent on every request and rebuilds the tar.gz in memory; fine for now but consider caching for production.

issues: DialogDescription still says 'Recibirás un token de emparejamiento de 12 caracteres.' but the new format is 14 characters (XXXX-XXXX-XXXX). Update copy in Devices.jsx line ~120.

action_items: Fix dialog copy in /app/frontend/src/pages/Devices.jsx: change 'token de emparejamiento de 12 caracteres' to '14 caracteres (XXXX-XXXX-XXXX)' to match the new format.
(Optional) Invalidate pairing_token after first successful /agent/pair so it cannot be re-used unless user regenerates it.
(Optional) Make /agent/event behave like /agent/thumbnail and return 413 instead of silently truncating an oversize thumbnail_b64.
(Optional, already noted in iteration_1) CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True is a CORS spec violation; set explicit origins for production.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_agent.get_current_agent does an inline import of `server.db` like the rest of the codebase — acceptable but fragile; consider db via FastAPI Depends or app.state.

routes_agent.download_agent walks /app/agent and includes every file. If __pycache__ is created at runtime (e.g. by importing the agent in tests) the filter is correct (skips __pycache__ parts). Good.
routes_agent.MAX_THUMB_B64_LEN = 250000 ≈ 187KB raw. Adequate for 480px JPEG q70 thumbnails as the agent generates.
models / device document grows over time with detected_cameras + cpu metrics — fine for now; eventually move detected_cameras and metrics to a TTL'd collection.
agent.py correctly saves the user-provided api_url (not the server-returned one). Verified explicitly via CLI test — config.json api_url == REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/api.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (updated token length assertion to 14 + regex XXXX-XXXX-XXXX)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of in-scope Phase 2 flows (download agent, paired device card grid, ONLINE badge, camera thumbnail rendering)

seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_PI_AGENT_1, TEST_PI_AGENT_2, TEST_CLI_PI, UI_PI_X, CAM_TEST_PI devices and TEST_AGENT_CAM, TEST_UI_CAM cameras. Cleanup tests delete created devices/cameras at end of each run. A few UI-created users remain (uitest+, camuit+ prefixes) for the admin to view.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 fully validated. The pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/{backend_test.py, test_agent.py} now covers 57 cases (Phase 1 + Phase 2). For Phase 3 (live streaming) add tests around MJPEG/WebRTC endpoints; for Phase 4 (Google Drive) test clip persistence; for Phase 5 (WhatsApp/Twilio) mock the Twilio client and test webhook notifications. The agent CLI is invoked via `cd /app/agent && python3 -m smartcam_agent.agent --config /tmp/test_cfg.json pair --token <TOK> --api-url $REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/api`. The agent's `run` command requires real /dev/video* devices and opencv-python; it cannot be fully exercised inside the preview cluster but the individual building blocks (heartbeat.send_heartbeat, client.upload_thumbnail, client.report_event) can be unit-tested via the public REST endpoints, which is exactly what /app/backend/tests/test_agent.py does.
rca of the issue: No critical bugs. Only nit found: Devices.jsx still says '12 caracteres' in the create-device dialog copy whereas the new token format is 14 characters. Single-line copy change in /app/frontend/src/pages/Devices.jsx.
